title: What's New: Admin Center MCP Server (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Admin Center MCP Server
Setup and Configuration in VS Code

features.name: Admin Center MCP Server
features.description: Lets you interact with the Admin Center API using natural language through an MCP server that can be connected to VS Code and other MCP-compatible clients.
features.status_evidence_quote: During the public preview, there are already a few scenarios where the MCP server can be really useful in managing your environments.
caveats: Some API endpoints available in Admin Center API are not yet known to the MCP server
Cannot execute potentially destructive operations like deleting and renaming environments or uninstalling apps
Settings related to linked Power Platform environments not available yet

features.name: Environment Management via Natural Language
features.description: Ability to query and manage Business Central environments using natural language queries, such as listing environments and checking their pending updates.
features.status_evidence_quote: For now, this is in public preview. So, we're still actively working on this and we have some ideas on how to improve it

features.name: Failed Update Analysis
features.description: The MCP server can analyze failed updates and identify root causes, especially when source code of extensions causing failures is available in the same context.

features.name: Extension Dependency and Update Management
features.description: The MCP server can help manage what extensions are installed on environments, their dependencies, and their updates.
caveats: Cannot uninstall apps during preview to avoid breaking changes

features.name: Environment Copy and Upgrade Polling
features.description: Ability to copy environments and poll for operation completion, useful for testing updates on production environments.

features.name: MCP Server Authentication
features.description: Uses standard Entra authentication, the same authentication mechanism as the Admin API, for setting up the MCP server.
